content: Deploying a Vite React SPA with client-side routing to GitHub Pages (project site) requires setting Vite's base to /<repo-name>/, setting react-router's basename to match, and because GitHub Pages has no server-side rewrite, deep-link/refresh requests 404 unless a 404.html fallback (copy of index.html, or the rafgraph spa-github-pages redirect script) is deployed alongside the build.
